//go:build kubeapiserver

// Copied into stackstate-agent pkg/collector/corechecks/cluster/ksm by
// generate.sh. It configures the kubernetes_state_core check as the cluster
// agent chart does, runs it against a fake clientset holding
// testdata/objects.json, and records the gauges as the aggregator keeps them.
package ksm

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/mock"
	batchv1 "k8s.io/api/batch/v1"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime"
	fakediscovery "k8s.io/client-go/discovery/fake"
	fakeclientset "k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/fake"
	"k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/scheme"

	taggerfxmock "github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/comp/core/tagger/fx-mock"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/aggregator/mocksender"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/comp/core/autodiscovery/integration"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/config/env"
	configmock "github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/config/mock"
	ksmstore "github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/kubestatemetrics/store"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/tagset"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/util/flavor"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/util/kubernetes/apiserver"
)

const (
	goldenClusterName = "golden_cluster"
	goldenClusterID   = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
)

// The chart's kube_state_metrics_core_conf with default values.
const goldenInstance = `
collectors:
  - nodes
  - pods
  - services
  - persistentvolumeclaims
  - persistentvolumes
  - namespaces
  - endpoints
  - daemonsets
  - deployments
  - replicasets
  - statefulsets
  - cronjobs
  - jobs
  - ingresses
  - secrets
  - resourcequotas
  - replicationcontrollers
  - limitranges
  - horizontalpodautoscalers
  - poddisruptionbudgets
  - storageclasses
  - volumeattachments
labels_as_tags:
  {}
annotations_as_tags:
  {}
`

type goldenSeries struct {
	Metric string   `json:"metric"`
	Host   string   `json:"host"`
	Tags   []string `json:"tags"`
	Value  float64  `json:"value"`
}

// goldenSender stands in for the check sender: it appends the check's custom
// tags and keeps one gauge per context, the last, as the check sampler does.
type goldenSender struct {
	*mocksender.MockSender
	checkTags []string
	series    map[string]goldenSeries
}

func (s *goldenSender) SetCheckCustomTags(tags []string) { s.checkTags = tags }

func (s *goldenSender) DisableDefaultHostname(bool) {}

func (s *goldenSender) Commit() {}

func (s *goldenSender) Gauge(metric string, value float64, hostname string, tags []string) {
	acc := tagset.NewHashlessTagsAccumulatorFromSlice(append(slices.Clone(tags), s.checkTags...))
	acc.SortUniq()
	sorted := slices.Clone(acc.Get())
	key := metric + "\x00" + hostname + "\x00" + strings.Join(sorted, "\x00")
	s.series[key] = goldenSeries{Metric: metric, Host: hostname, Tags: sorted, Value: value}
}

func TestGenerateKSMGolden(t *testing.T) {
	resources, objects := loadGoldenFixture(t, os.Getenv("GOLDEN_FIXTURE"))

	// The fake clientset does not send the bookmark that ends a watch-list stream.
	t.Setenv("KUBE_FEATURE_WatchListClient", "false")
	t.Setenv("DD_ORCHESTRATOR_CLUSTER_ID", goldenClusterID)
	cfg := configmock.New(t)
	cfg.SetWithoutSource("cluster_name", goldenClusterName)
	cfg.SetWithoutSource("skip_validate_clustername", true)
	cfg.SetWithoutSource("hostname", "cluster-agent")
	env.SetFeatures(t, env.Kubernetes)
	flavor.SetFlavor(flavor.ClusterAgent)
	t.Cleanup(func() { flavor.SetFlavor(flavor.DefaultAgent) })

	client := fakeclientset.NewClientset(objects...)
	client.Discovery().(*fakediscovery.FakeDiscovery).Resources = resources
	if err := apiserver.SetGoldenAPIClient(client); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	k := newCheck(taggerfxmock.SetupFakeTagger(t), nil).(*KSMCheck)
	demux := mocksender.CreateDefaultDemultiplexer()
	if err := k.Configure(demux, nil, 1, integration.Data(goldenInstance), nil, "golden", "golden"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Run skips leader election only for a cluster check runner.
	k.isCLCRunner = true
	k.instance.LeaderSkip = true

	s := &goldenSender{MockSender: mocksender.NewMockSenderWithSenderManager(k.ID(), demux)}
	s.On("ServiceCheck", mock.Anything, mock.Anything, mock.Anything, mock.Anything, mock.Anything).Return()
	if err := demux.SetSender(s, k.ID()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	// The bubble's clock stands still while the informers fill the stores, so
	// every duration and age the check derives from time.Now is fixed.
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		start := time.Now()

		s.series = map[string]goldenSeries{}
		t.Cleanup(k.Cancel)
		if err := k.Run(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		synctest.Wait()
		requireStoresSynced(t, k, objects)

		s.series = map[string]goldenSeries{}
		if err := k.Run(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !time.Now().Equal(start) {
			t.Fatalf("clock moved from %v to %v", start, time.Now())
		}
	})

	out := make([]goldenSeries, 0, len(s.series))
	for _, series := range s.series {
		out = append(out, series)
	}
	slices.SortFunc(out, func(a, b goldenSeries) int {
		return strings.Compare(a.Metric+"\x00"+a.Host+"\x00"+strings.Join(a.Tags, "\x00"),
			b.Metric+"\x00"+b.Host+"\x00"+strings.Join(b.Tags, "\x00"))
	})
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("GOLDEN_OUTPUT"), append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func loadGoldenFixture(t *testing.T, path string) ([]*metav1.APIResourceList, []runtime.Object) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var items []json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &items); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var resources []*metav1.APIResourceList
	var objects []runtime.Object
	for _, item := range items {
		var meta metav1.TypeMeta
		if err := json.Unmarshal(item, &meta); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if meta.Kind == "APIResourceList" {
			var list metav1.APIResourceList
			if err := json.Unmarshal(item, &list); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			resources = append(resources, &list)
			continue
		}
		obj, _, err := scheme.Codecs.UniversalDeserializer().Decode(item, nil, nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// The API server defaults suspend; v2.13's kube_cronjob_next_schedule_time
		// dereferences it.
		if cj, ok := obj.(*batchv1.CronJob); ok && cj.Spec.Suspend == nil {
			cj.Spec.Suspend = new(bool)
		}
		objects = append(objects, obj)
	}
	return resources, objects
}

// requireStoresSynced fails unless every fixture object type has a store with
// metrics in it.
func requireStoresSynced(t *testing.T, k *KSMCheck, objects []runtime.Object) {
	t.Helper()
	filled := map[string]bool{}
	for _, stores := range k.allStores {
		for _, store := range stores {
			if ms, ok := store.(*ksmstore.MetricsStore); ok && len(ms.Push(ksmstore.GetAllFamilies, ksmstore.GetAllMetrics)) > 0 {
				filled[ms.MetricsType] = true
			}
		}
	}
	for _, obj := range objects {
		if kind := fmt.Sprintf("%T", obj); !filled[kind] {
			t.Fatalf("no store holds %s objects", kind)
		}
	}
}
